name: Kill
why: Serves the role as it is.

name: Spare
meaning: hold a life at the edge, for capture or mercy
why: Kept; its skill now reads 'capture' as claiming the body: a kneeling Spared enemy can be raised without waiting for a corpse.

name: Animate
why: The core necromancer verb. Kept; Rise Again now walks three dead at once.

name: Lay
why: Serves the role as it is.

name: Rot
why: Serves the role as it is.

name: Preserve
meaning: stop decay: in the dead you keep, and in your own body
why: Its skill moved from the caster ('cannot die for 5 s', which was too strong and served no role) to the thralls: a necromancer preserves its dead. Role and draw kept; the effect still reads as 'lasts longer'.

name: Haunt
meaning: what dies lingers as a spirit
why: Serves the role as it is.

name: Exorcise
why: Kept as the utility pair: Death's answer to constructs and casters.

name: Vanish
meaning: pass out of sight and reach
why: Kept; its skill now also swaps with a thrall.

name: Manifest
why: Kept; the likeness can now be made from a corpse.

name: Bid
meaning: the dead do your bidding: send them, and they go
why: A necromancer needs a way to aim its dead. A Link (it takes the word in and passes it on to the thralls); draw +0.6 because it holds the dead to your will.

name: Unbind
meaning: let your dead go, and what held them goes outward
effect: reach x1.2; power x1.15; duration x0.8
why: The sacrifice that every necromancer kit has: the thralls as a resource to spend. A Branch (one release spreads into a burst round every body), draw -0.7 because it releases outward; opposite Bid's hold, so the pair bonds ionically.
